caption: The drawing features two objects set against a plain, light background. On the right side, there is a dark brown, wooden object with a flared, bowl-like top and a narrower, rounded pedestal base, giving it an hourglass appearance. To the left of this object, there is a circular, light-colored disk or lid with a pattern of small black dots arranged in the shape of a five-pointed star in its center. The name "MILTON R. BEVIER" is typed in small, capital letters near the lower right corner of the drawing. Both objects are carefully shaded, providing a sense of depth and three-dimensionality.
title: Sand Blotter
